tha-ap114:2.1: nhatvā pitvā → nahātvā pītvā (bj); nahātva pītvā (pts) | nhatvā → nhātvā (sya-all) | Nahātva → G. nhātvā. (pts note) | ca → G. pitvāna; S2 pivitvā-. (pts note)
tha-ap114:3.4: apphoṭesiṁ → appoṭhesiṁ (bj, sya-all) | appoṭhesiṁ → G. appoḍesi; S1 appoṭesi; M. apphoṭesi. (pts note)
tha-ap114:4.1: sataraṁsiṁva → satarasmiṁ va (pts) | Satarasmiṁ → G. M. sataraṁsī. (pts note)
tha-ap114:4.2: kañcanaṁ → iminā pādadvayena purimapādadvayassa purato bhavitabbaṁ (cck note)
tha-ap114:4.3: naccagīte payuttohaṁ pañcaṅgatūriyamhi → nacce gīte (sya-all) | yutto’haṁ → naccagīte payuntohaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | yutto → M. G. payutto; S1 payato. (pts note)
tha-ap114:4.4: ca → ca yuttohaṁ pañcaṅgaturiyepica (sya-all) | ca → pañcaturiyasatamhi ca (bj note) | pañcaturiyatamhi → S2 -turasatam hi; S1 M. satam pi. (pts note)
tha-ap114:5.3: abhibhomi → atibhomi (bj); atihomi (pts) | atihomi → G. anubhomi; M. atibhomi. (pts note)
tha-ap114:5.4: yaso → ayañca gāthā pariggahetigāthāya anantarameva ṭhātuṁ yuttā (cck note)
tha-ap114:6.4: muni pariggahe → mune pariggayha (bj); mune paṭiggahetvā (pts) | mune → G. S1 muni. (pts note)
tha-ap114:7.1: pariggahe → pariggahitvā (sya-all) | pariggayha → paṭiggahetvā (bj: PTS, sī.selu); pariggahe (bj: machasaṁ) | Pariggahe → pariggayha (cck: sī.); pariggahitvā (cck: syā.); pariggahena (cck: ka.)
tha-ap114:7.2: subbate upaṭṭhahitvā → subbato upaṭṭhahitvāna (sya-all) | subbate → subbato (bj: sīmu)
tha-ap114:8.2: dvinavaekacintitā → davi nava ekacintitā (bj); dvinavā ekacintitā (sya-all, pts)
